title.narrative: Multisector IDP and Famine Emergency Response in Ed Diaen, East Darfur

description.narrative: ltpgtIn response to the critical needs of displaced populations in Ed Daein, East Darfur, World Vision and AAO will undertake life saving interventions directly benefitting 46313 people ltbgtWASHlt/bgt-To address the acute water shortages, the consortium will facilitate water trucking for 3,750 IDPs over three months ensuring safe drinking water through chlorination. Emergency water distribution points will be installed at 12 locations in Almanar, Lagawa, and Sabreen to provide easier access to clean water. Six 10M³ water bladders will be installed at the same locations for water storage and distribution, ensuring water availability during peak demand. In addition, a borehole in Almanar will be rehabilitated and solarized to ensure a sustainable water supply. 50 gender and disability sensitive shared latrines will be built to serve 300 vulnerable individuals, ensuring access to safe and hygienic sanitation facilities. Hygiene kits, tailored to the specific needs of women and girls, will be distributed to 1,000 IDPs, and regular garbage collection campaigns will be conducted to maintain a clean environment. Training 50 community hygiene volunteers will enhance community awareness of hygiene and sanitation. ltbgtHealth-lt/bgt Essential health services will be provided through one mobile and four fixed clinics, offering outpatient consultations, Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI), nutrition services, communicable and non-communicable disease control, pharmacy services, and minor surgery. Health awareness campaigns and outreach vaccination drives will enhance health-seeking behavior and improve vaccination coverage in IDP camps and host communities. Basic reproductive health services, including antenatal care, labor and delivery, post-natal care, and family planning, will be made available.ltbgtNutrition interventions lt/bgtwill focus on both preventive and curative actions. Community management of acute malnutrition will be key with lead mothers conducting active case finding and mass MUAC assessments to identify malnourished children early. Curative services will be integrated at the PHU with OTP included. Infant and young child feeding in emergencies will promote and support appropriate feeding practices for infants and mothers. Breastfeeding corners will provide social support for mothers facing mental health issues.ltbgtProtection-lt/bgt Protection services will focus on the most vulnerable, including unaccompanied and separated children. Case management and mental health support will be provided to 200 children. Six community-based child protection networks will be established to address child protection and GBV issues at the local level. Training for community members will cover child protection, GBV, prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse and referral pathways. Protection monitoring will be conducted using key informant methods to gather critical information and respond to emerging protection concerns. A community feedback mechanism will be established to allow IDPs to report issues and seek assistance. Dignity kits will be distributed to 3,000 at risk women and girls, including GBV survivors, to support their hygiene and dignity. Awareness-raising sessions on GBV will target 3,000 individuals to improve understanding and prevention of gender-based violence, with public sessions scheduled around key dates like the 16 Days of Activism and International Women’s Day. Printed materials with GBV and PSEA messages will also be disseminated to enhance community awareness. ltbgtNon-Food Items-lt/bgtTo support the displaced populations immediate material needs, NFIs will be distributed to 6000 people. This will include plastic sheets, mats, utensils and blankets. Community representatives will be engaged in the beneficiary identification and registration process to ensure transparency. The distribution process will be closely monitored with results shared with key stakeholders. Protection training on PSEA will also be provided to suppliers, community leaders, and project staff.lt/pgt
